UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Authenticated learner profile, 3D game HUD currency (XP, coins, hearts, streak), grade target, active human AI tutor, and unlocked collectible items.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

selectedGrade.description: Target CSAT high school grade (1, 2, or 3).

coins.description: Game coins earned from missions to unlock 3D collectible rewards.

lastStudyDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of the most recent study activity.

unlockedItems.description: Bounded list (max 30) of unlocked 3D collectible badge/item IDs.

kakaoUserId.description: Optional normalized KakaoTalk account identifier (kakao_<id>) linked by this Firebase user.

connectedKakaoIds.description: Optional bounded list (max 30) of normalized KakaoTalk friend identifiers (kakao_<id>) synced via Kakao Friends API.

FamilyStreakEntry.title: FamilyStreakEntry
FamilyStreakEntry.description: Non-PII daily streak leaderboard record keyed by normalized KakaoTalk ID (kakao_<id>) or uid_<firebaseUid>, readable only by the owner and connected Kakao Friends when shareWithFriends is true.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

kakaoUserId.description: Normalized KakaoTalk user ID (kakao_<id>) or empty string if not linked.

displayName.description: Public family leaderboard display nickname (1..40 chars).

avatarUrl.description: Optional sanitized https:// profile thumbnail URL.

streakCount.description: Current consecutive daily study streak count (0..10000).

lastStudyDate.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of the most recent study activity.

shareWithFriends.description: Opt-in privacy flag controlling whether connected Kakao Friends can read this streak entry.

WordMastery.title: WordMastery
WordMastery.description: Per-word CSAT Sparta mastery statistics and speaking score.

mastered.description: Whether the word passed both Sparta quiz and shadowing speaking drill.

ScenarioProgress.title: ScenarioProgress
ScenarioProgress.description: Completion progress across the 100 traveler scenarios and twist roleplays.

completedSentencesCount.description: Completed sentences in this scenario (0 to 30).

twistCleared.description: Whether the dynamic travel twist mission was cleared.

bestFluencyScore.description: Best pronunciation and fluency score (0 to 100).

StudySessionLog.title: StudySessionLog
StudySessionLog.description: Immutable training session record capturing accuracy, WPM, XP, and coins earned.

teacherId.description: AI human tutor who coached the session.

accuracyPercent.description: Pronunciation and response accuracy percentage (0 to 100).

wpm.description: Measured words per minute fluency metric.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile, game currency, streak, Kakao linkage metadata, and unlocked collectible items.

/familyStreaks/{entryId}.description: Daily streak leaderboard entries shared between connected KakaoTalk friends via Firebase Authentication.

/users/{userId}/wordMastery/{wordId}.description: Per-word CSAT G1-G3 Sparta mastery tracking.

/users/{userId}/scenarioProgress/{scenar.description: Progress across 100 traveler scenarios and twist missions.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Immutable session telemetry for fluency, WPM, XP, and coins.
